title: Data and normalizations for the component slice square
statement: Fix a commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. On the finite-cover profinite slice over $S$, put $\operatorname{Modules}(\Lambda,S)=\operatorname{Mod}(\Lambda_S)$, where $\Lambda_S=q_S^*\Lambda$ [lem-zl-component-relative-profinite-site]. For a map $T\to S$, RestrictionData consists of literal precomposition restriction, its strong braided tensor structure extending the prescribed lax structure, the section-identity coefficient isomorphism, exactness on module objects, and the balanced tensor equation. For an affine scheme $W$, PullbackData packages the actual component inverse image, its exact braided structure, its absolute coefficient factorization, and its normalized unbounded evaluation [lem-sfb-component-pullback-unbounded-evaluation]. For an affine pro-etale $U\to W$, OrdinaryComparison is a natural isomorphism $r_UF_W\cong F_Ur_T$ whose value on each w-contractible affine test $V\to U$ is the identity on $M(\pi_0(V)\to\pi_0(W))$, transported by componentCompositionIso. OrdinaryMonoidal asserts its monoidality with the scheme restriction tensor structure transported from native upper star. DerivedComparison is ExactSquareComparison for the exact termwise localization of this same isomorphism: it records derived tensor structures with their homotopy-representative and unit equations, normalized right-derived sections, the evaluation and section squares for internal Hom, their formula on every integer-shifted Hom, and the fully faithful isomorphism test. The classes of sections are fixed using the degree-zero coefficient identity and the canonical homology shift; their Hom identification must send each such class to the evaluation transpose. These are record types and formula predicates, without an assertion of inhabitance.
